run_flat_l2_search: run a brute-force L2 nearest neighbor search using faiss IndexFlatL2 on random float32 vectors
run_flat_ip_search: run an inner-product nearest neighbor search using faiss IndexFlatIP on L2-normalized vectors
build_ivf_pq_index: build an IVF32,PQ8 index using faiss index_factory, train it, add vectors, and search
run_hnsw_search: run an HNSW approximate nearest neighbor search using faiss IndexHNSWFlat on random vectors
test_serialize_deserialize_index: test serializing a faiss IndexFlatL2 to bytes and deserializing it back with matching results
